title: Tate — What's on
creator: Tate
observed_layout: Unified exhibitions+events listing, filter panel (Location/Date/Type/Audience/Price), Grid/List toggle, '1–20 of 163 items'
visual_hierarchy: Title then venue, date range, access status label
interaction_pattern: Date presets (On now and coming soon/Today/This weekend/Next week), 'Only free events' toggle, collapsible filter panel, each item a standard hyperlink
useful_principle: Multi-venue filtering with date presets and price-status labels; every item is a real URL
do_not_copy: Tate's exact filter taxonomy, label copy and card layout
notes: WebFetch 요약 기반(원문 미대조). No sort observed.

title: Whitney — Exhibitions
creator: Whitney Museum of American Art
observed_layout: Tabs Current/Upcoming/Online/Public art/Archive, image grid cards
visual_hierarchy: Large title, smaller dates, status labels
interaction_pattern: 'Last chance' and 'On view' status labels; dark mode and reduced-motion toggles
useful_principle: Status labels (last chance) support time-based decision

title: MMCA 국립현대미술관 — Home
creator: 국립현대미술관
observed_layout: Home: exhibition cards with location filter buttons (전체/서울/과천/덕수궁/청주/어린이미술관)
visual_hierarchy: Thumbnail, title, location, dates, audio-guide indicator
interaction_pattern: Venue filter as always-visible buttons on home; current/upcoming/past list URLs

title: Leeum·Hoam gateway
creator: 리움·호암미술관
observed_layout: Gateway portal splitting to two museum sites; no exhibition list
visual_hierarchy: Two museum blocks with WEBSITE/TICKETS/MEMBERS QR
useful_principle: Counter-example: splitting venues into separate entry points pushes comparison burden to the user

title: Whitney — A New Graphic Identity (Experimental Jetset, 2013)
creator: Experimental Jetset
observed_layout: Identity used as frame/grid/stage for text and images (search metadata + official page)
visual_hierarchy: Mark as structural device, not ornament
typography_character: Grotesk typography alongside mark (per search summary: Neue Haas Grotesk)
expressive_device: 'Responsive W' — zig-zag line that adapts to artworks and words around it
composition_character: Mark becomes layout framework (frame, grid, stage)
artwork_character: Artwork placed inside/under the mark's structure
image_treatment: Images positioned beneath the responsive line
useful_principle: Derive one flexible brand motif that structures layout instead of adding separate decoration — applicable to SeMA's 'S = connection/change/flexibility'
do_not_copy: The W zig-zag shape itself and Whitney's layouts
notes: 공식 페이지 인용: 'a dynamic W that responds to the artworks and words around it'. 서체명은 검색 요약(dezeen 등) 기반.
